question.html:
In two experiments X and Y measurements were made of the kinetic energies Ek of photoelectrons emitted when light is incident on two different metal surfaces.

The graph shows the variation of Ek with frequency  of the incident photons for both surfaces.

It can be deduced that in experiment Y…

[1]

  1. the surface has a smaller work function than the surface in experiment X.
  2. the surface has a larger work function than the surface in experiment X.
  3. the intensity of the incident light is less than in experiment X.
  4. the intensity of the incident light is more than in experiment X.
